purpose: One command row inside a DropdownMenu, with optional icon, media, description, shortcut, control, caret and selection check. The critical variant marks irreversible commands. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a DropdownMenu.
An option in a searchable value picker.
A navigation row in a side rail.

Default.visual: No fill; label and leading icon Content/primary (critical: Status/critical/content); description and trailing Content/secondary.

Focused.visual: Fill Surface/muted plus a ring 1 px off the row in Border/ring/default (critical: Status/critical/surface with Status/critical/ring).

Selected.visual: Fill Surface/selected and a check in Content/accent at the end.

Disabled.visual: Label, description, trailing and leading icon in Content/disabled; no fill.

a11y.keyboard: Reached with the menu's arrow keys and typeahead; Enter / Space activate it and close the menu; skipped when disabled (Radix DropdownMenu).
notes: Put irreversible commands last as the critical variant.
Fill and ink change with the motion role use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).
